---
title: "Ex25: Multi-Compartment Cells"
description: "Cells with multiple dendritic compartments connected to a network"
---

## Model: Multi-Compartment Network

Demonstrates multi-compartment cells with explicit morphology (soma + dendrites)
connected in a network. Each segment has its own channel populations.

The channels use standard HH kinetics.

---

## 1. Define HH Cell in TVBO

```{python}
from tvbo import SimulationExperiment

exp = SimulationExperiment.from_string("""
label: "NeuroML Ex25: HH Multi-Compartment"
dynamics:
  name: HodgkinHuxley
  parameters:
    C:     { value: 10.0 }
    g_Na:  { value: 1200.0 }
    g_K:   { value: 360.0 }
    g_L:   { value: 3.0 }
    E_Na:  { value: 50.0 }
    E_K:   { value: -77.0 }
    E_L:   { value: -54.3 }
    I_ext: { value: 0.08 }
  derived_variables:
    alpha_m:
      equation:
        rhs: "Piecewise((1.0, Eq(v, -40.0)), (0.1*(v + 40.0)/(1.0 - exp(-(v + 40.0)/10.0)), True))"
    beta_m:
      equation:
        rhs: "4.0*exp(-(v + 65.0)/18.0)"
    alpha_h:
      equation:
        rhs: "0.07*exp(-(v + 65.0)/20.0)"
    beta_h:
      equation:
        rhs: "1.0/(1.0 + exp(-(v + 35.0)/10.0))"
    alpha_n:
      equation:
        rhs: "Piecewise((0.1, Eq(v, -55.0)), (0.01*(v + 55.0)/(1.0 - exp(-(v + 55.0)/10.0)), True))"
    beta_n:
      equation:
        rhs: "0.125*exp(-(v + 65.0)/80.0)"
  state_variables:
    v:
      equation:
        rhs: "(-g_Na*m**3*h*(v - E_Na) - g_K*n**4*(v - E_K) - g_L*(v - E_L) + I_ext*1000) / C"
      initial_value: -65.0
      variable_of_interest: true
    m:
      equation: { rhs: "alpha_m*(1 - m) - beta_m*m" }
      initial_value: 0.05
    h:
      equation: { rhs: "alpha_h*(1 - h) - beta_h*h" }
      initial_value: 0.6
    n:
      equation: { rhs: "alpha_n*(1 - n) - beta_n*n" }
      initial_value: 0.32
network:
  number_of_nodes: 1
integration:
  method: euler
  step_size: 0.01
  duration: 300.0
  time_scale: ms
""")
print(f"Model: {exp.dynamics.name}")
```

## 2. Render LEMS XML

```{python}
xml = exp.render("lems")
print(xml[:1200])
```

## 3. Run Reference

```{python}
import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(".")))
from _nml_helpers import run_lems_example

ref_outputs = run_lems_example("LEMS_NML2_Ex25_MultiComp.xml")
for name, arr in ref_outputs.items():
    print(f"  {name}: shape={arr.shape}")
```

## 4. Run TVBO

```{python}
import numpy as np

result = exp.run("neuroml")
da = result.integration.data
tvbo_arr = np.column_stack([da.coords['time'].values, da.values])
print(f"TVBO: shape={tvbo_arr.shape}")
```

## 5. Plot Reference

```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

for name, ref_arr in ref_outputs.items():
    t = ref_arr[:, 0] * 1000
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 4))
    n_show = min(ref_arr.shape[1] - 1, 8)
    for i in range(1, n_show + 1):
        ax.plot(t, ref_arr[:, i] * 1000, alpha=0.7, label=f'Comp {i}')
    ax.set_xlabel("Time (ms)")
    ax.set_ylabel("Voltage (mV)")
    ax.set_title(f"Ex25: Multi-Compartment — {name}")
    if n_show <= 6:
        ax.legend(fontsize=7)
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
```

::: {.callout-note}
## Multi-Compartment in TVBO
Explicit morphology and per-segment channel populations are NeuroML-native features.
TVBO represents the HH channel dynamics per compartment; the inter-compartment
axial resistance coupling is handled by the NeuroML adapter.
:::
